name: Foley Eileen M., Lawyer (E. Foley Firm)
what_they_do: Solo family-law practice handling divorce litigation, child custody/parenting time, child support, alimony, domestic violence, DCP&P matters, pre-nuptial and settlement agreements. The site says she has practiced since 1990 and serves Middlesex, Monmouth, Mercer and Somerset counties from an East Brunswick office.
customers: Divorcing and separating spouses and parents in Middlesex County and surrounding towns; the site says most clients arrive by referral.

size_signals.signal: Solo attorney who says matters are handled 'start to finish by Ms. Foley'
Middlesex County Bar Association 2024 Pro Bono Attorney of the Year; opened her solo practice in 2016
Practice described as 'since 1990'; one office at 330 Milltown Rd W21

website_review.primary_cta: Text line 'Call 732-360-8116' plus an email link; no form
website_review.out_of_date_signs: HTTPS fails with a self-signed certificate warning; Chrome blocked the plain-http copy; empty meta description; leftover template sample-slider code in the HTML; most recent blog post is from 2017; jQuery 1.7.2; misspelled mailto 'efole@efoleyfirm.com'
website_review.search_basics: Title names divorce/family law and the counties but not East Brunswick; meta description is empty; practice areas have their own pages (divorce.html, child-custody.html, child_support.html); no LocalBusiness/Attorney schema
top_issues: Site cannot be opened safely over https - visitors get a certificate warning
No contact or consultation form anywhere on the site
Empty meta description and no structured data
Content and template visibly stale (2017 blog, old scripts)

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: GBP exists with hours ('Closed - Opens 9 AM'), category 'Family law attorney' and correct address/phone, but zero reviews and no photos; site is listed. Answerable: services and service area are real text on the http site and robots.txt is a plain 404 (nothing blocked), but https fails, meta description is blank and there is no JSON-LD. Bookable: no form, no scheduler, no tel: link - an agent has only an email address and a phone number.

operations_signals.signal: All intake is phone/email; no web form, so after-hours enquiries depend on the solo attorney answering
Site states 'when you contact ... your matter will be handled start to finish by Ms. Foley' - no staff visible to absorb intake

top_opportunities.opportunity: Get the site onto a valid HTTPS certificate and add a mobile click-to-call bar
top_opportunities.evidence: https://www.efoleyfirm.com returns ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID / self-signed certificate; no tel: links on the page

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add a consultation-request form (matter type, county, contact) that emails or creates a CRM lead, plus an auto-reply
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page offers only mailto and a fax number; no <form> on the site at all

top_opportunities.opportunity: Build a review-request routine to get the first Google reviews and photos onto the unrated profile
top_opportunities.evidence: Google listing shows no rating and 'Write a review' with no existing reviews, and no photos

scores.reasons: Gap: broken SSL, no form, no schema, no reviews - almost everything a customer's agent needs is missing. Pay: solo matrimonial practice with real retainer fees but no staff or multiple offices. Ease: a week of small fixes covers the top items. Evidence: direct inspection of the site HTML, cert error and GBP card.
